CVE-2026-119793.title: libp2p: gossipsub creates a permanent topics-map entry per distinct subscription with no cap in the default config
CVE-2026-119793.description: libp2p is a JavaScript implementation of the libp2p networking stack. Prior to 17.0.0, the @libp2p/gossipsub default configuration allows a connected remote peer to submit unsigned subscription RPC metadata for arbitrarily many distinct topic strings. handleReceivedSubscription in packages/gossipsub/src/gossipsub.ts creates a persistent topics-map entry for each accepted topic, while allowedTopics is unset by default, decodeRpc maxSubscriptions limits only one RPC rather than aggregate topic bytes, and peer scoring has no subscription-volume penalty. A single peer can therefore grow the topics map and committed heap toward out-of-memory conditions, and disconnecting additionally causes removePeer to scan all accumulated topic entries. This issue is fixed in version 17.0.0.

CVE-2026-123886.title: Spring Data Elasticsearch SpEL Expression Injection through String-based Query Method Arguments
CVE-2026-123886.description:
Spring Data Elasticsearch replaces positional placeholders in string-based @Query methods with the method arguments before it evaluates SpEL expressions in the resulting query string.

As a result, an argument that contains a SpEL expression is evaluated as part of the query, even if the declared query does not use SpEL.

An application is affected if it passes untrusted input as an argument to a repository query method that declares a @Query with positional placeholders.

In that case, a remote attacker can execute arbitrary code in the application, and repeated requests can exhaust memory through the unbounded expression cache.

Before a redirect to another origin, it removes the Authorization and Cookie headers it knows about. But the decorated client then added its own default options again. CVE-2026-62365.title: Wazuh: Heap Buffer Overflow in DecodeWinevt() join_data Accumulation via Crafted EventChannel XML
CVE-2026-62365.description: Wazuh is an open-source security platform providing unified XDR and SIEM protection for endpoints and cloud workloads. DecodeWinevt in src/analysisd/decoders/winevtchannel.c accumulates unnamed Windows EventChannel Data element contents into the fixed 65,535-byte join_data heap buffer but passes the growing content length, rather than the OS_MAXSTR buffer capacity, as the snprintf size. An enrolled agent can submit an EventChannel message containing four maximum-sized unnamed Data elements, causing the fourth accumulation to write beyond join_data and corrupt adjacent heap metadata. The subsequent free of join_data2 causes the wazuh-analysisd process to terminate, stopping log ingestion for all agents handled by that manager. This vulnerability is fixed in 4.14.7.

CVE-2026-71534.title: Mareforma: transparency_logged trusts the unsigned rekor block
CVE-2026-71534.description: Mareforma is a local verification layer for AI-assisted research. From 0.3.0 until 0.3.8, restore logic in mareforma/db/restore.py derives transparency_logged from the unsigned rekor.uuid field inside signature_bundle without requiring a verified claim-bound rekor_inclusions entry, so an attacker who modifies claims.toml can falsely make a claim eligible for REPLICATED convergence. The same logic resets signed claims in non-Rekor graphs from transparency_logged 1 to 0 after restore, permanently preventing convergence because no Rekor refresh is configured. This issue is fixed in version 0.3.8.

CVE-2026-74762.title: Apache Shiro: Possible session fixation with RememberMe
CVE-2026-74762.description:
Apache Shiro is vulnerable to session fixation when a user is authenticated via the "Remember me" functionality. In affected versions, when a subject is restored from a "Remember me" cookie, the existing session is not invalidated, nor is a new session created with a new ID.
Additionally, session IDs were accepted from the request URL even when session ID URL rewriting was disabled.
This issue affects all Apache Shiro versions through 3.0.0, only when RememberMe functionality is enabled.

Mitigation: Upgrade to version 3.0.1 or later, which fixes the issue by invalidating the existing session and creating a new session with a new ID when a subject is restored from a "Remember me" cookie, and by ignoring session IDs in the URL when URL rewriting is disabled.

CVE-2026-78191.title: WebDyne versions from 2.031 before 3.022 for Perl execute files with .psp anywhere in the name as Perl pages
CVE-2026-78191.description:
WebDyne versions from 2.031 before 3.022 for Perl execute files with .psp anywhere in the name as Perl pages.

WebDyne decides whether to run a requested file as a page by matching its name against WEBDYNE_PSP_EXT_RE, which has no end anchor.

An application that accepts uploads by checking only the final extension lets a remote attacker upload a file such as report.psp.pdf and run its embedded Perl by requesting it.

CVE-2026-99349.title: rxrpc: Fix lack of short-send handling in rxrpc_kernel_send_data()
CVE-2026-99349.description:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

rxrpc: Fix lack of short-send handling in rxrpc_kernel_send_data()

Fix rxrpc_kernel_send_data() to loop around if it detects a short send.
David Laight suggested doing it here rather than wrapping all the calls in
loops. Further, remove the len argument and use the iterator count instead
and return 0 on success, not the amount copied.

Note this is also a prerequisite for changing the way rxrpc_send_data()
works to return a short send rather than an error if some data was
buffered.

CVE-2026-99666.title: mm/khugepaged: fix PMD table lock leak in try_collapse_pte_mapped_thp()
CVE-2026-99666.description:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

mm/khugepaged: fix PMD table lock leak in try_collapse_pte_mapped_thp()

For a private mapping with userfaultfd, try_collapse_pte_mapped_thp()
takes the PMD table lock before it maps the page table for the second time.
If that (pte_offset_map_rw_nolock) fails, because the page table vanished
in the meantime due to concurrent page table reclaim, it leaves through
the abort label, where the PMD table lock is unlocked if it differs from
PTE table lock.

In case the PMD table lock and the PTE table lock match, which is the
case without CONFIG_SPLIT_PTE_PTLOCKS after pte_offset_map_rw_nolock()
failed, we miss to unlock the PMD table.

To fix it, forget the PTE table lock when we unmap+unlock the PTE table.

Fix generated by an LLM and sent by Josef Bacik in private.
